description: Search for bookable tours, activities, excursions, and experiences at a destination using GetYourGuide with Viator and Tiqets travelpayouts fallbacks. Returns tour options with titles, prices, ratings, durations, and booking links. Use when the user asks about things to do, tours, activities, excursions, or experiences in a city or destination. Search one destination per call.

currency.description: Optional ISO-style three-letter currency code. Omit to use the user's preferred currency, then the currency of the trip given by trip_id, then USD.

date.description: Optional date in YYYY-MM-DD format to filter tours available on that day.

limit.description: Maximum number of tour results to return (default 10, max 30).

provider.description: Preferred tour provider to search ('all', 'getyourguide', or 'viator'). Default is 'all'.

query.description: Search query for ONE destination, optionally with an activity type (e.g. 'walking tour Rome', 'snorkeling Cancun'). Never list several cities in one query: for a multi-city trip, call this tool once per city.

trip_id.description: Optional Tineo trip ID (from trips_list) this request is for. Used only to default the currency to that trip's currency when currency is omitted and the user has no preferred currency; ignored if the trip is not found or not accessible to the user.

name: search_tours
title: Search Tours & Activities
